description: This file implements an OpenSearch aggregation job worker for Mattermost, managing job creation, claiming, execution, index management, and cleanup within the enterprise Elasticsearch/OpenSearch integration.

classes.name: OpensearchAggregatorInterfaceImpl
classes.description: Implements the interface to create workers for OpenSearch aggregation jobs.

classes.name: OpensearchAggregatorWorker
classes.description: Handles the lifecycle and execution of aggregation jobs, including claiming, running, monitoring, and cleanup.

methods.name: MakeWorker
methods.description: Creates and returns a new OpensearchAggregatorWorker instance.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the worker, establishing a client connection and processing jobs until stopped.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the worker is enabled based on license features and configuration.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the worker gracefully, waiting for ongoing jobs to finish.

methods.name: JobChannel
methods.description: Returns the channel for submitting jobs to the worker.

methods.name: DoJob
methods.description: Claims and executes a given job, managing index reindexing and cleanup.

methods.name: setJobSuccess
methods.description: Marks a job as successfully completed.

methods.name: setJobError
methods.description: Marks a job as failed with an error.
